player.name: Jalen Brunson
player.physicalDescription: 6'1" point guard, strong build, crafty scorer, known for high basketball IQ and clutch performances. Notable features include his unwavering focus and determined expression.
player.archetype: Undersized lefty closer who attacks from the side no one is watching

figure.name: Ehud
figure.attributeDescription: a cubit-long double-edged short sword strapped to his right thigh, hidden under his cloak where no one thought to look
figure.visualStyle: lean, quick Benjamite judge, ancient Israelite deliverer
figure.clothing: plain belted tunic and cloak, leather sandals, cloak draped to conceal the right thigh
figure.physicalDescription: lean and wiry rather than towering, sharp watchful eyes, short dark beard, ready stance leading with the LEFT hand
figure.archetype: The left-handed deliverer nobody saw coming

connection.thematic: Overlooked and undersized, both win by attacking from the side no one is watching
connection.narrative: Ehud was the lefty nobody searched. Brunson is the lefty nobody can stay in front of. Both deliver when it counts.
connection.relationship: Underestimated left-handers who strike before anyone sees it coming
connection.receipt: No. 33 pick in 2018; led the Knicks to their first conference finals since 2000

Jalen Brunson and Ehud standing together as equals
